name: Sentinel
description:
A giant robot that breaks apart to protect a boy.
Sentinel starts with four Components in play: Head, Arms, Torso and Legs. Each one is a tool, and each one is armor: take a hit and flip a Component to its Destroyed side instead. Expose enemies, crush them with Rocket Punch and Exterminate, then rebuild with Reinforced Plating. With Juston Seyfert at his side and Mark VII-A on his trail, every point of damage is a choice. Includes a Justice starter deck and his art for Reboot and Size Advantage. 26 cards. English and Spanish. Pairs with Mutant Genesis.
